Goal `core-router-and-4-more` is reached. All five classes owe nothing: `Core\Router`, `Core\Router\Match`, `Core\Script`, `Core\Script\ExitReport` and `Core\Secret`. `bun nv proofs --verify --group` for each prints `nothing owed`, `0 failed` and `0 failed`. `bun nv verify --doc` is green, and `bun nv owners --closes` and `bun nv playbook --closes` for this goal name nothing.

`Core\Secret` now has its class card, and it is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. Its two member cards are rewritten to `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads*. `reveal` and `revealBytes` each have an about, three examples, an attack, a bench with a recorded figure, and a Rust `#[test]` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/secret.rs`. The attacks found no bug: 10,000 kept reveals of a 16 MB secret share one allocation, and changing one copy leaves the others alone.
